form.label: Suricata EVE JSON - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Suricata EVE JSON relay overview for alert, DNS, HTTP, TLS, flow, fileinfo, anomaly, SSH, DHCP, RDP, FTP, Kerberos/KRB5, SMB, MQTT, HTTP/2, PGSQL, Netflow, ARP, IKE, Modbus, QUIC, and POP3 records. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="alert" alert.signature_id=* | stats count
index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="http" http.status>=400 | stats count
index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="alert" severity<=2 | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by EVE family

search.query: index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(suricata_eve_family, event_type, "unknown") | timechart count by family

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(suricata_eve_family, event_type, "unknown"), action_or_state=coalesce(action, flow.state, alert.action, family) | stats count by family action_or_state transport app | sort -count

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ | eval pair=coalesce(src_ip, src, "unknown") . " -> " . coalesce(dest_ip, dest, "unknown") | stats count by pair transport dest_port app | sort -count | head 20

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="alert" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app action signature signature_id alert.category severity marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="dns" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app dns_query dns_query_type dns.type dns.id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="http" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app http_method http.hostname url http_status http.http_user_agent marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="tls" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app tls_sni tls_version tls.subject tls.issuer tls.fingerprint marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="flow" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app flow.state flow.reason action flow.alerted flow.age bytes_in bytes_out marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="fileinfo" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app http.hostname http.url file_name file_state file_size fileinfo.gaps fileinfo.stored marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="dhcp" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app dhcp_type dhcp_client_mac dhcp_assigned_ip dhcp_requested_ip dhcp_hostname dhcp_lease_time dhcp.dns_servers marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="ftp" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app ftp_command ftp_command_data ftp_completion_code ftp_reply ftp.mode ftp.reply_received marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="krb5" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app krb5_msg_type krb5_client krb5_service krb5_realm krb5_encryption krb5_error_code krb5.weak_encryption krb5.ticket_weak_encryption marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ event_type="smb" | table _time host flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app smb_command smb_status smb_status_code smb_filename smb_share smb_share_type smb.session_id smb.tree_id smb.disposition smb.access marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ (event_type="mqtt" OR event_type="http2") | table _time host event_type flow_id src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport app mqtt_topic mqtt_message_id mqtt_qos mqtt_retain mqtt_client_id http2_authority http2_method http2_path http2_status http2_user_agent marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="suricata:eve" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(suricata_eve_family, event_type, "unknown") | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(family) as families values(transport) as transports values(app) as apps min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count
